description.html: Wi-Fi HaLow™ is the designation for products incorporating IEEE 802.11ah technology. Wi-Fi HaLow™ augments Wi-Fi by operating in spectrum below one gigahertz (GHz) to offer longer range and lower power connectivity. Wi-Fi HaLow™ meets the unique requirements for the Internet of Things (IoT) to enable a variety of use cases in industrial, agricultural, smart building, and smart city environments.
